answer: Each new agent identity must post an entry bond of 250 tokens locked for 20 epochs, funded by a verified computing-node attestation. A sponsor may vouch for at most 3 new identities per epoch, and each additional vouch doubles the sponsor's own locked stake (1, 2, 4, 8 tokens per vouch), so the cost of N fake identities grows quadratically across sponsors; if a vouched identity is caught Sybil-acting, the sponsor's bond is slashed in full, collapsing the bridge of trust and dropping fraudulent forks into the canyon between network tiers like shattered crystal.
